requirement: Document the authorized business and technical owners for the RMM service
pilot_test: Name the service owner and technical owner during kickoff
acceptance_criteria: Both owners accept responsibilities in writing

requirement: Support separate customer or site scopes with documented ownership
pilot_test: Create two test sites and verify scope boundaries
acceptance_criteria: A scoped technician cannot view or act on the other site

requirement: Export an auditable record of administrative changes and privileged actions
pilot_test: Change a policy and run a privileged action in the pilot
acceptance_criteria: Actor time target and result appear in an exportable record

requirement: Provide a documented cloud service boundary and regional data-processing information
business_reason: Clarifies operational and data residency assumptions
pilot_test: Review the vendor architecture and data-flow evidence
acceptance_criteria: Evidence identifies service components subprocessors and data locations

requirement: Describe agent communication ports destinations proxy behavior and certificate validation
business_reason: Enables safe network approval and troubleshooting
pilot_test: Install behind the representative proxy and egress controls
acceptance_criteria: Agent enrolls and checks in without broad firewall exceptions

requirement: Continue local endpoint operation during a temporary console outage
business_reason: Avoids turning console loss into endpoint failure
pilot_test: Interrupt console connectivity on a pilot endpoint
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint remains stable and queued behavior matches documentation

requirement: Require multi-factor authentication for technician and administrator accounts
pilot_test: Enroll a pilot technician and attempt sign-in without the second factor
acceptance_criteria: Protected roles cannot bypass the approved MFA policy

requirement: Support least-privilege roles for view remote control scripts patching and administration
business_reason: Separates routine support from privileged change authority
pilot_test: Create representative viewer technician and administrator roles
acceptance_criteria: Each role can perform only the approved actions

requirement: Revoke a technician session and access promptly after disablement
pilot_test: Disable a pilot account while a session is active
acceptance_criteria: New access is blocked and active access ends within the approved target

requirement: Define endpoint health signals with explicit thresholds persistence and recovery conditions
business_reason: Turns telemetry into reviewable operational rules
pilot_test: Trigger and clear one representative health condition
acceptance_criteria: Alert opens only after the defined condition and closes with evidence

requirement: Route alerts by customer site severity schedule and responsible queue
pilot_test: Trigger alerts across two sites and two severities
acceptance_criteria: Every alert reaches the intended owner without cross-customer leakage

requirement: Correlate repeated events without deleting underlying evidence
business_reason: Reduces noise while preserving investigation history
pilot_test: Generate repeated events for one condition
acceptance_criteria: One incident retains the count timestamps and underlying event trail

requirement: Expose acknowledgement response and resolution timing for service review
business_reason: Supports operational measurement without inventing SLA evidence
pilot_test: Acknowledge and resolve a controlled pilot alert
acceptance_criteria: Exported timestamps support the defined calculations

requirement: Define approval rings maintenance windows deadlines reboot behavior and exceptions
business_reason: Makes patch deployment controlled and repeatable
pilot_test: Assign two pilot rings and schedule one approved update
acceptance_criteria: Policy behavior matches the documented window deadline and reboot rules

requirement: Report installed pending failed excluded and unknown patch states separately
business_reason: Prevents unknown state from being reported as compliant
pilot_test: Create one endpoint in each representative patch state
acceptance_criteria: Report distinguishes every state and links the affected endpoint

requirement: Record patch exceptions with owner reason evidence expiry and retest date
business_reason: Stops temporary deferrals becoming permanent gaps
pilot_test: Create and expire a pilot exception
acceptance_criteria: Expired exceptions return to an owned review queue

requirement: Require explicit target preview before running a script or automated action
pilot_test: Preview a pilot action against a mixed endpoint group
acceptance_criteria: Preview shows the exact included and excluded targets

requirement: Support staged rollout stop conditions and bounded concurrency
pilot_test: Run a harmless test through pilot and expanded waves
acceptance_criteria: Execution pauses on the defined failure condition and respects concurrency

requirement: Preserve script version parameters actor output and per-endpoint result
pilot_test: Run a versioned test script on two endpoints
acceptance_criteria: Audit evidence identifies inputs actor time output and result per endpoint

requirement: Require authorized technician identity and capture remote-session start and end
pilot_test: Open and close a pilot remote session
acceptance_criteria: Session evidence identifies technician endpoint start end and outcome

requirement: Support customer consent or documented unattended-access policy by endpoint class
business_reason: Aligns access behavior to service agreements
pilot_test: Test one attended and one approved unattended endpoint
acceptance_criteria: Each endpoint follows its assigned consent policy

requirement: Revoke remote-access capability independently from general monitoring
pilot_test: Disable remote access for one pilot endpoint
acceptance_criteria: Monitoring continues while new remote sessions are blocked

requirement: Maintain durable endpoint identity across rename IP change reboot and agent update
business_reason: Prevents duplicate or orphaned asset records
pilot_test: Rename and update a pilot endpoint
acceptance_criteria: The same managed record persists with a traceable history

requirement: Export current endpoint ownership operating system agent version and last check-in
pilot_test: Export the pilot inventory
acceptance_criteria: Every managed endpoint has the required fields and observation time

requirement: Identify stale duplicate retired and unmanaged records for review
pilot_test: Create representative stale and retired pilot records
acceptance_criteria: Each exception is visible with an owner and disposition path

requirement: Provide documented security reporting vulnerability intake and incident contact paths
business_reason: Enables coordinated response to product risk
pilot_test: Review public and contractual response paths
acceptance_criteria: Current security and incident contacts are available before purchase

requirement: Support export or preservation of audit and operational evidence before termination
pilot_test: Export representative pilot evidence
acceptance_criteria: Export is complete readable timestamped and independent of the live subscription

requirement: Document agent removal access revocation residual cleanup and post-removal verification
pilot_test: Remove the agent from a pilot endpoint and revoke access
acceptance_criteria: Service process scheduled tasks credentials and console access are reconciled

requirement: State implementation dependencies training responsibilities and measurable acceptance criteria
business_reason: Turns deployment promises into an owned plan
pilot_test: Review the proposed implementation plan against the pilot scope
acceptance_criteria: Owners dates dependencies deliverables and acceptance evidence are explicit

requirement: Disclose billing unit minimum commitment required add-ons renewal changes and termination terms
pilot_test: Reconcile quote order form and standard terms
acceptance_criteria: Year-one renewal and exit costs can be calculated from dated evidence

requirement: Describe support channels service hours escalation path and severity targets
pilot_test: Open a non-production pilot support request
acceptance_criteria: Routing ownership and timestamps can be verified

requirement: Provide a tested data export and transition path without requiring continued privileged access
pilot_test: Run an exit rehearsal with pilot data
acceptance_criteria: Required records export and privileged access can be removed cleanly
